# agar-extension

## Functions

### agentExtensionMethods()

```ts
function agentExtensionMethods<Context>(
  extension,
): Readonly<Record<string, AppBackendMethod<Context>>>;
```

Serve one Shiitake extension from this App backend. Spread the result into
`defineAppBackend({ methods })`; the build writes the three methods into the
Release's API, which is how a Release declares itself an Agent extension. An
extension requesting a capability hosting lacks fails here, at build.
